description: Apply a list of drawing operations to the active schematic page as ONE change: afterwards either all of it is on the page or none of it. The netlist is read before and after (guard): nets with different names that became one net are a short, and a short takes the whole change back, as does a failed op or an `expect` that does not hold; the report says what happened to the nets (connected, joined, dropped, split, renamed) and `restored:true` confirms that the netlist is back to what it was. trial:true does the change, reports, and takes it back in any case (a dry run on the real editor). ops: {op:'wire',line:[x1,y1,x2,y2,...],net?} | {op:'part',lcsc:'C1234'|device:{libraryUuid,uuid},x,y,rot?,mirror?,des?} | {op:'flag',kind:'Ground'|'Power'|'AnalogGround'|'ProtectGround',net,x,y,rot?} | {op:'port',dir:'IN'|'OUT'|'BI',net,x,y,rot?} | {op:'move',part:'R1',x?,y?,rot?,mirror?} | {op:'set',part,props:{designator?,name?}} | {op:'nc',pin:'U1.3'} | {op:'unname',wire:id} | {op:'rewire',wire:id,line} | {op:'delete',wires?:[ids],parts?:[ids|designators],others?:[ids of texts/shapes]} | {op:'text',x,y,text,size?,rot?,color?} | {op:'rect',x,y,w,h} (x,y top left) | {op:'circle',x,y,r} | {op:'line',line:[...]} (drawing line, not a wire) | {op:'attr',part,key:'Designator'|'Name',x?,y?,rot?,visible?,value?} (move or edit a label of a part). Notes: y points up; a wire with `net` gets a visible label; EasyEDA merges a new wire with every wire whose end it touches (reported as merged, the old wire keeps its id); pins touching end to end without a wire are not connected; parts placed without `des` are numbered by EasyEDA (unique across all pages); the netlist also numbers any other 'R?' part of the project; deleted parts cannot be put back by a rollback.

allowShorts.description: true, or a list of net names that may be joined on purpose.

expect.description: {NET: ['U1.3','R2.1']}: these nets must consist of exactly these pins afterwards, else the change is taken back. A key starting with '?' checks an unnamed net.

guard.description: Default true. false skips the two netlists (faster, no short detection).

keepGoing.description: Continue after a failed op (turns rollback off unless it is set).

rollback.description: Default true: take everything back on a failed op, a short or a failed expect. false keeps what was done.

trial.description: Do it, report what it does to the nets, then take everything back.

verbose.description: Return an entry for every op, not only parts and problems.

name: sch_draw
